    • enrichAuditDatasetFromResponse

      public boolean enrichAuditDatasetFromResponse(FhirQueryAuditDataset auditDataset, Object response, AuditContext auditContext)
      Description copied from class: FhirQueryAuditStrategy
      Fills in the patient from the query string, for the client side.

      This runs here rather than in FhirQueryAuditStrategy.enrichAuditDatasetFromRequest(FhirQueryAuditDataset, Object, Map) because the query string does not exist yet when that is called: the client audit dataset only learns it once HAPI has built the request, which happens on the way out. Without it a client record could never name the patient, and would be stepped down to a weaker profile than the server record of the same transaction.

      Specified by:
      enrichAuditDatasetFromResponse in interface AuditStrategy<FhirQueryAuditDataset>
      Overrides:
      enrichAuditDatasetFromResponse in class FhirQueryAuditStrategy
      Parameters:
      auditDataset - audit dataset
      response - response object
      auditContext - audit context
      Returns:
      whether the transaction is to be considered successful
